description: Un'thuwa, tribal mage of Sen'jin Village, detects a disturbance in the magic currents of Durotar and asks for aid.  Speak with Un'thuwa and do what you can to help him.
Do this, and in time further secrets will be revealed to you.
completion: Hail, <name>. Praise to you, for my call for aid is now answered. Let us hope you are up to the task...
